findings.span: SNS 업로드용 최소 길이 충족을 위해 짧은 클립에 자연스러운 꼬리 추가.
findings.suggestion: 소셜 미디어 납품물: 최소 재생 시간 요건을 충족하도록 짧은 클립에 자연스러운 꼬리 추가.
findings.reason: The English label 'Social deliverables:' is dropped, breaking the parallel labelled structure of the other items.
'내보내기 합니다' is ungrammatical noun+verb phrasing a native speaker would not write; the verb form '내보냅니다' is correct.
Uses '트림' while the extendedDescription, howToUse and FAQ all use '트리밍' for the same operation; inconsistent terminology across the entry.
The title renders 'talent casting' as '탤런트 캐스팅'; here the same concept becomes '인재 캐스팅' (HR-style wording), which is inconsistent within the page and off-register for advertising.
Awkward noun phrase; the adverbial '이미지에서 비디오로' cannot modify the noun '미리보기' naturally in Korean.
Inconsistent with the metaDescription, which uses '이미지-투-이미지' for the same source term 'image-to-image'.
The step label 'STEP 2' is kept in English everywhere else (extendedDescription, howToUse) but is localized as '2단계' here, breaking consistency with the workflow's group names.
'identity' is rendered as '정체성' elsewhere (extendedDescription, FAQ) but transliterated as '아이덴티티' here, producing inconsistent terminology across the page.

The workflow name is rendered three different ways across the page: transliterated in the title (헤어스타일 체인저), translated in the description (헤어스타일 변경 워크플로), and kept in English in the extendedDescription/howToUse (Hairstyle Changer). Readers see these together, so one consistent form is needed.
Uses 셀카 for 'selfie' while the description, metaDescription, extendedDescription and howToUse all use 셀피; inconsistent terminology within the same page.
